profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Cloud Engineer
profile.summary:
I work across concept development, architecture, and server site development to deliver custom Digital Products that solve real life dilemmas. I love building Digital Products from start to finish, and been doing so for the last 10 years.

I am constantly learning and acquiring new skills, right now I’m focusing my learning tactics on becoming a Cloud-Native Engineer.  If you're looking for someone who is not afraid of undertaking new challenges, shoot me a message!  I understand there is always a better way to do things and our work can always (and should always) improve.

I can work with:
• Product development, from definition and architecture to MVP and iterations
• API layering, Action layering, MVC’s and anything needed to develop fully fledged products
• Design and management of Cloud-Native development and infrastructure 
• Mobile application development
• User interface development and data modeling
• Mentoring and managing other developers

Skills: JavaScript (React, React Native, Vue JS, TypeScript, Node JS, Nest JS, Redux); Databases (Mongo DB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle SQL, SQL, NoSQL); GraphQL; Python; PHP (Laravel, WP); HTML|CSS; Git; TDD (Jasmine, Jest, Cypress); Cloud-Native (Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, AWS, Azure, Microservices)

positions.title: Specialist, Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Specialist Software Engineer at Nationwide Insurance, I design and develop robust APIs, work with observability and monitoring for batch and Kubernetes jobs, and craft dynamic front-end solutions using Angular and back-end development utilizing Java. Also, work driving efficient database solutions through Oracle SQL and contributing to innovation through active participation in hackathons and the implementation of cutting-edge GenAI Tools.

• API Design and Development: Create scalable and efficient APIs that power seamless application interactions, enhancing user experiences and data flow.

• Observability and Monitoring: Adept at optimizing Observability and Monitoring strategies for batch and Kubernetes jobs, ensuring system health and performance through meticulous analysis.

• Front-end Development (Angular): Develop accessible user interfaces using Angular, merging aesthetics with functionality for exceptional web applications.

• Backend Development (Java): Building robust server-side applications that support critical business functionalities.

• Database Development (Oracle SQL): Implement efficient database solutions using Oracle SQL, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.

• Hackathon Participation: Actively engaged in hackathons, leveraging innovative thinking to implement GenAI tools and Python to contribute to advancing cutting-edge technologies.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Front-end Development · Angular · API Development · TypeScript · Back-End Web Development · Java · Oracle SQL · Docker · Kubernete

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Vana Solutions, I help launch new products and maintain legacy ones using a variety of tools.  We develop software using SCRUM and Agile methodologies, resulting in focused results and growth.  I work in both development and design, focusing on interactive implementations to launch valuable and usable products.  Along with developing web-based products, I also managed to:

• Addressed as Project Lead Developer the need to create a custom CMS for an enterprise section of the AFRL with Java Spring Boot Web App Development and Oracle SQL DB; which includes a HUB that serves as a central communication space for technology arms 

• Mobile iOS App Development with Swift for a commercial retail contract building a POS (Point of Sale) System for iPads

• Cloud migration of a legacy app, refactored the codebase in Classic ASP to be compatible with Azure, and refactored the SQL server to be compatible with Azure SQL

• Assessed as Project Lead Developer to improve scalability and code performance of an AFRL application, which required heavy equations analysis to show analytical graphics on data processing KPIs; and enhanced speed performance on the first load and continued load, improving general cache

• Developed web applications using SharePoint, and its Restful APIs, AngularJS, React, and TypeScript.  Using SCRUM/Agile software development practices within stakeholders' organizations while participating in project decisions and solutions
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Full-Stack Development · Front-end Development · Angular · API Development · TypeScript · Agile Methodologies · Back-End Web Development · Software Design · Microsoft Azure · Mobile Application Development · React · Java · Cloud Computing · Oracle SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked as Lead Software Engineer at Think Telic, a Digital Product Firm where we work with small to medium-sized businesses to help integrate modern technology platforms into their business.  Clients have been in pharmacy management solutions, entertainment, marketing, and art industries.  I've had the opportunity to develop several custom web products, mobile apps, and cloud software and services. 

• Assessed as Project Lead Developer, the requirements to developed, built, and managed a mobile app pharmacy platform. Built API first; Monolithic REST API built on NodeJS, My SQL; hosted on AWS EC2 Instance using AWS S3 Bucket for secure encrypted storage. For management, I created a single web application using React and Typescript. I also developed an API Key Communication between the REST API and the mobile app.

• Focused on API Design and architecture (API layer | Action Layer | MVC, REST and RESTful) using NodeJS (NestJS), MySQL, PostgreSQL and TypeScript

• Containerized development environments with Docker and Docker-Compose

• API Testing using Postman

• Project API's integrations and documentations

• Data Modeling, Business Logic to meet business needs

• Server Management | Configurations, Cloud Computing (AWS, Digital Ocean)

• Build CI/CD infrastructure Integration using GitHub actions 

• File storage management and encryption using AWS s3 Bucket

• Developed and architect Custom Learning Management (CLM) system using Laravel, React, and MySQL

• Security (encryption on transit and on rest, hashing, and token) and policy compliance like HIPAA

• Developed web application focusing on accessibility and usability
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · Node.js · Front-end Development · API Development · TypeScript · React Native · Back-End Web Development · Databases · Full-Stack Engineer · Mobile Application Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React · Cloud Computing · MySQL · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (StayTuned)
positions.description:
I worked with StayTuned (now SourceLid), a YouTube Partner, to help modernize its technology stack and level up its team and customers with a goal-focused custom web application. 

The software allowed company management to have a central place where their customers uploaded files and documentation, and all data was automatically classified.  The customers could upload media files, have a customizable profile, and receive a monthly report. This software allowed for better management and simplified building rapport with their customers. 

Within this system:
• Architecture and developed the dashboard for both partners and admins 

• Worked the cloud computing configuration and setup using Laravel Forge and Digital Ocean

• Web Security (encryption on transit and on rest, hashing, and token) 

• File storage management and encryption using AWS s3 Bucket
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · Amazon S3 · API Development · Databases · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloud Computing · MySQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
OnTime Soft, Inc. is one of the most reliable community pharmacy service providers in Puerto Rico. They are conscious of the current changes in the digital space and the pharmacy industry. I partner with them to renew their online presence to impact pharmacy owners, employees, and future Pharmacists.

I developed a Learning Management System (web app development, dashboard design, admin and user log-in systems) used by their clients (pharmacy owners), students, and professional Pharmacists, allowing them to learn more about processes and best practices.  Additionally, I designed and developed a custom corporate website with a custom-built CMS and Landing Page Generator, so they can continuously add new workshops and promote them independently.

Within this system:
• Designed and developed a full-stack application to display videos, classes, and courses

• Developed a data visualization tool that analyzed the employee's courses progress

• Configured Cloud computing services (DNS, SSL, and subscriptions)

• Built a custom URL shortening to help them share articles and workshop registration forms 

• and developed a custom CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system to keep a safe and well-structured client database
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · Back-End Web Development · Databases · Full-Stack Engineer · Cloud Computing · MySQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a freelancer, I've worked in all production aspects of web apps, SAAS, APIs, among others. From brainstorming, defining requirements, structuring architecture to developing the Front and Back-End while working with engineers, designers, product owners, and business people to make sure everything comes together. I've provided support to various businesses, developing tools that helped companies achieve long-term success; some of them:

• Developed a complete e-commerce back-end system solution to help an established distributor reach more customers and expand their business online

• Created a WordPress plugin that helped a group of artists gain more subscribers and expand their network 

• Managed code reviews and consulted startups and solo pressures

• Contributed, developed, and designed a variety of web applications, tools, and APIs
